title: Classic Modern Nether
description: A pack that remakes the Nether in the classic "Programmer Art" art style.
body:
# Classic Modern Nether

![Crimson Forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94c42f89a28d067661da26d46a965a93bf59159c.png)

This pack gives Programmer Art equivalents to many modern Nether textures, while also giving a face lift to some old ones. Newer mobs also get classic style textures.

Keep in mind that while this pack has 99% of the textures used in the Nether, and hence can be used by itself, some textures (Obsidian, Netherbricks, etc) aren't included as they come in the built-in Programmer Art resource pack. Items (like Netherite, gold and equipment) and derivatives of the wood blocks (planks, doors, trapdoors, signs, buttons) also don't have their own textures in this pack. It's highly suggested to use this pack in conjunction with Programmer Art and or a pack of your choosing that already bridges the gap between Programmer Art and the modern textures. Check out my pack [Programmer Art Updated](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/programmer-art-updated) if you're looking for one of the packs that overhauls the new textures. If you're only interested in the cleaner version of the classic Netherrack texture, check out [Clean Classic Netherrack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/clean-classic-netherrack).

**Note: Make sure this pack is placed above other packs that change these same textures for it to work properly**

![Intended pack order](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c3a272a114b92ef7652d58e967505f9aae2c1e9.png)


**Feel free to use this pack in any free projects, just credit me somewhere.**
